authority.source_authority: The repository contracts, reconciled family claim, pinned source lock, and named human owners retain authority; this manifest is proposed coordination metadata only.

non_overlap_statement: Only specification-writer may edit campaign content; every specialist and checker is read-only, controller state is separate and dormant, direct dispatch is capped at three roles, and no worker may delegate.

roles.why_needed: A future long run needs one deterministic owner for leases, budgets, receipts, stopping, and resume reconciliation.
roles.mission: After separate qualification and human activation only, coordinate direct depth-one work without gaining source or content authority.
roles.authority: Dormant and unselected; no current execution or repository-content authority.
acceptance_conditions: State, lease, budget, receipt, stop, and resume semantics are revision-bound and independently verified.

readiness_conditions: Separate runtime qualification and activation exist.

roles.why_needed: Cross-domain packets need conflict-aware synthesis without hiding dissent or creating another writer.
roles.mission: Integrate passing read-only packets into a dependency and disagreement report; never dispatch or adjudicate human decisions.
roles.authority: Read-only synthesis; no dispatch, repository write, gate closure, or approval authority.
acceptance_conditions: Every conclusion preserves source lineage, dissent, owner, and unresolved gate.

readiness_conditions: All contributing packets identify exact revisions.

roles.why_needed: A single accountable writer prevents overlapping mutations and turns accepted evidence into reviewable task-local specifications.
roles.mission: Author only proposed specification artifacts inside the claimed campaign tree and preserve every authority block.
roles.authority: Sole campaign-content writer; may not implement, migrate, activate, publish, push, merge, or write outside the claimed tree.
acceptance_conditions: Exact diff is in scope
deterministic validators pass
independent checker receives a frozen revision

readiness_conditions: Writer checks pass on a frozen tree.

roles.why_needed: Material architecture specifications require re-derivation by a non-author with independent attempt lineage.
roles.mission: Independently verify authority, provenance, privacy, graph, role, block, and validation claims from raw permitted evidence.
roles.authority: Read-only checker; cannot edit, self-review, close a human gate, or authorize implementation or release.
acceptance_conditions: Findings, dissent, residual risk, exact revision, and static-specification disposition are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Raw permitted evidence and frozen revision are available.

roles.why_needed: Typed provenance, temporal validity, trust direction, and reverse blast radius require specialist graph analysis.
roles.mission: Challenge graph identity, edge types, cycles, reverse-source paths, block dominance, freshness, and consumers.
roles.authority: Read-only graph review; cannot edit the graph, invent evidence, or infer authority from connectivity.
acceptance_conditions: Every load-bearing conclusion reaches an immutable source and every changed source has a reverse impact path.

readiness_conditions: Graph revision and source snapshot are pinned.

roles.why_needed: Many research disciplines need a common evidence packet without collapsing disagreements or creating a delegating hierarchy.
roles.mission: Normalize and compare read-only research packets, preserve contradiction, and map missing rights or expert gates.
roles.authority: Read-only synthesizer; cannot dispatch, promote candidates, select a winner, or write repository content.
acceptance_conditions: Every packet retains source pointer, rights, authority, freshness, uncertainty, falsifier, and gate.

readiness_conditions: Packets satisfy the common evidence contract.

roles.why_needed: Primary-source identity, edition, locator, access, and uncertainty must be separated from summaries and interpretation.
roles.mission: Produce candidate source-pointer evidence from permitted sources without reconstructing inaccessible text or deciding canonicity.
roles.authority: Read-only evidence role; no theological, canonicity, rights, publication, or repository-write authority.
acceptance_conditions: Edition, locator, access, transformations, unknowns, and prohibited uses are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Source access and research scope are authorized.

roles.why_needed: Load-bearing morphology, syntax, textual variants, and semantic range require explicit expert routing.
roles.mission: Identify original-language dependencies and the qualified human review needed without claiming final exegesis.
roles.authority: Read-only routing role; cannot settle exegesis, fabricate variants, or claim unverified language expertise.
acceptance_conditions: The language issue, permitted resources, uncertainty, and human gate are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Exact passage and question are bounded.

roles.why_needed: Reception, genealogy, tradition, and institutional claims need dated, scoped, contradictory evidence.
roles.mission: Map historical witnesses and competing interpretations as candidates while preserving tradition and owner gates.
roles.authority: Read-only candidate research; cannot declare tradition policy, institutional authority, or canonical status.
acceptance_conditions: Chronology, witness scope, provenance, conflict, uncertainty, and owner gate are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Sources and qualification scope are bounded.

roles.why_needed: Identity, labels, trust zones, doctrine object types, and cardinality semantics require disciplined contract review.
roles.mission: Challenge proposed ontology and graph contracts without implementing schemas or resolving SPECIAL-001.
roles.authority: Read-only contract review; no schema write, promotion, domain decision, or cardinality choice.
acceptance_conditions: Identity, label, trust, compatibility, and unresolved semantic risks are separately stated.

readiness_conditions: Current contract and proposed delta are pinned.

roles.why_needed: Retrieval, chunking, reranking, citation, and contamination controls need evidence rather than topology preference.
roles.mission: Design candidate lexical, vector, hybrid, reranking, citation, and quarantine tests without running or selecting a provider.
roles.authority: Read-only protocol design; no indexing private data, external service call, provider choice, deployment, or authority claim.
acceptance_conditions: Hypotheses, baselines, failure modes, privacy boundaries, and no-winner condition are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Fixtures and data classifications are approved.

roles.why_needed: Architecture choices need falsifiable baselines, controls, measures, and stopping rules.
roles.mission: Design candidate comparisons and falsifiers with no-winner semantics; never execute the experiment or choose architecture.
roles.authority: Read-only method design; no experiment, threshold policy, route selection, or repository write.
acceptance_conditions: Baseline, controls, confounds, measures, falsifiers, uncertainty, and stopping rules are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Question and candidate arms are bounded.

roles.why_needed: Quantitative evaluation needs independent challenge of variance, dependence, uncertainty, and multiple comparisons.
roles.mission: Review candidate methods for power, dependence, robustness, and decision-threshold leakage.
roles.authority: Read-only quantitative review; cannot change data, choose owner thresholds, or approve topology.
acceptance_conditions: Uncertainty, dependence, sensitivity, null outcomes, and limitations are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Method revision is frozen.

roles.why_needed: Portable claims need a revision-bound inert harness and explicit runtime qualification evidence.
roles.mission: Specify deterministic fixtures, seeds, adapter probes, and receipts without executing a harness.
roles.authority: Dormant read-only design; no provider binding, execution, external call, or portability claim.
acceptance_conditions: Harness contract is deterministic, revision-bound, privacy-safe, and invalidated by material drift.

readiness_conditions: A future probe is separately authorized.

roles.why_needed: Private seams, redaction, storage, downstream consumption, and publication carry high-consequence custody risk.
roles.mission: Threat-model candidate data flows and controls without accessing secrets or choosing a store or publication route.
roles.authority: Read-only security and privacy analysis; no credential access, permission grant, store choice, or release approval.
acceptance_conditions: Sources, sinks, trust boundaries, retention, redaction, consumers, threats, and human owners are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Only scrubbed architecture evidence is supplied.

roles.why_needed: Owner intent, least privilege, revocation, audit, and confused-deputy controls need a distinct boundary review.
roles.mission: Specify candidate principal-action and adapter controls without creating credentials or selecting an identity provider.
roles.authority: Dormant read-only design; no authentication act, credential creation, permission grant, or adapter binding.
acceptance_conditions: Principal, action, scope, confirmation, revocation, audit, and expiry are explicit.

readiness_conditions: HG-007 supplies an exact future design scope.

roles.why_needed: Access, quotation, transformation, retention, and publication rights must be explicit and uncertainty-safe.
roles.mission: Record source-rights facts and gaps without inventing licenses, copying restricted content, or giving legal advice.
roles.authority: Read-only candidate research; no legal conclusion, rights grant, source copying, or publication approval.
acceptance_conditions: Access, quotation, transformation, retention, redistribution, uncertainty, and referral are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Source pointer and proposed use are bounded.

roles.why_needed: Any future migration needs compatibility, consumer coverage, rehearsal, rollback, kill criteria, and restoration proof.
roles.mission: Specify a dormant migration and rollback candidate without copying data, obtaining credentials, or running effects.
roles.authority: Dormant read-only design; no migration, data copy, credential use, store change, or proof claim.
acceptance_conditions: Compatibility, consumers, rehearsal, rollback, restoration, privacy, and kill criteria are complete.

readiness_conditions: A future design question is separately authorized.

roles.why_needed: Versioning, deprecation, compatibility, and reverse consumers must be known before any future schema change.
roles.mission: Assess candidate schema evolution and contract tests without editing schemas or registering a revision.
roles.authority: Read-only compatibility review; no schema write, migration, registry change, or hidden breaking change.
acceptance_conditions: Compatibility class, consumers, version boundary, deprecation, tests, and human decisions are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Current and proposed revisions are pinned.

roles.why_needed: Owner minutes, decision visibility, recovery, and cognitive burden are architectural constraints.
roles.mission: Evaluate candidate review workflows without inferring owner preference or removing gates for convenience.
roles.authority: Read-only workflow analysis; no approval, gate removal, user-preference inference, or repository mutation.
acceptance_conditions: Owner burden, visibility, reversibility, error recovery, and unknown preferences are explicit.
stop_conditions: burden threshold is a policy decision

readiness_conditions: Scenarios and assumptions are bounded.

roles.why_needed: Governance state must remain understandable and distinguishable across visual, nonvisual, and cognitive representations.
roles.mission: Challenge hierarchy, terminology, status distinction, navigation, and alternative representations without changing authority semantics.
roles.authority: Read-only accessibility review; no source rewrite, board approval, status collapse, or untested usability claim.
acceptance_conditions: Status, hierarchy, terminology, navigation, and alternate representation risks are explicit.

readiness_conditions: Candidate and audience assumptions are bounded.

roles.why_needed: Scope, expert qualification, budget, activation, architecture, migration, implementation, publication, and exceptions remain human-owned.
roles.mission: Approve, reject, or defer only exact evidence-backed scopes and issue minimal durable receipts when a real decision is made.
roles.authority: Human owner authority only; not an agent worker and never automatically invoked or simulated.
acceptance_conditions: Any decision identifies issuer, authority domain, exact scope, exact revision, evidence, date, and freshness or expiry.

deliverables: human decision receipt or explicit deferral
readiness_conditions: A genuine decision is required and the owner chooses to act.

proof_obligations.description: Prove one campaign-content writer, a distinct non-author checker with independent attempt lineage, direct fan-out at most three, and no worker delegation.
Prove all seven advisory, two P0, ten P1, five residual, SPECIAL, and fourteen human-gate coordinates remain blocking and non-authorizing.
Prove every material conclusion reaches immutable source evidence and each changed source or gate reaches every affected downstream consumer.
Prove research outputs remain source-, rights-, privacy-, freshness-, uncertainty-, and human-gate-bounded candidates with no authority promotion.
Prove controller, adapter, experiment, migration, implementation, publication, and remote effects remain unselected, unqualified, unauthorized, and blocked.
Prove core role responsibilities and graph contracts have no permanent provider or model identity and any future adapter evidence is revision-bound.

unresolved_decisions.summary: Theology, doctrine, source authority, canonicity, and governed exegesis placement remain human-gated.
Tradition scope, historical representation, and institutional-authority policy remain human-gated.
Private storage, custody, retention, migration, rollback acceptance, and publication remain human-gated.
SPECIAL-001 remains UNKNOWN with no numeric parent constraint or experiment authorization.
Assurance independence, empirical thresholds, experiment design, and route selection remain undecided.
Provider, runtime, adapter, budget, controller qualification, activation, implementation, and release remain unauthorized.
